title: Humanizer: an agent skill for revising formulaic AI prose
friendlyTitle: A skill that helps clean up robotic AI writing
summary: Humanizer is a portable agent skill that identifies common patterns associated with generic AI-generated writing and guides a rewrite in plainer language. It supports skill and plugin installation across several coding-agent environments.
friendlySummary: Humanizer gives AI agents a checklist for finding stiff, repeated or overly polished writing patterns.
whyItMatters: Writers and editors can use its pattern checklist as a revision pass for drafts, while still reviewing facts, voice and originality themselves. It is best treated as an editing aid, not proof that text is human-written.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as one editing pass to make a draft clearer. A person should still check the facts and final voice.
